title: Serious Sam - The First Encounter
_note: The engine resolves its .gro files against the CURRENT DIRECTORY, which the template's cd /d and start /D both give it. MARKER is a per-disc .gro and deliberately NOT Install\Bin\SeriousSam.exe, which is the file the CD check itself opens: it is on BOTH Encounters' discs, so it would let the wrong one report success. Same class as BF1942's Setup.ini marker. The launcher writes the RESOLUTION only and never sam_iDriver: the engine auto-detects its renderer and persists it, and pinning OpenGL made this title unstartable on .246.
